plugins.name: skill-forge
plugins.description: Auto-distill reusable skills after multi-step tasks, and keep the skill library fresh and within budget.

plugins.name: memory-loop
plugins.description: Close the memory loop: consume hook-written memory candidates, split them per project, and re-inject distilled memory at session start.

plugins.name: project-guardrails
plugins.description: Per-project guardrails that work around ZCode ignoring workspace-scoped hooks: declare constraints and tool rules in <repo>/.zcode/guardrails.json and have a user-level plugin enforce them.
